q-212206.name: Question 11
q-212206.problem: Let $a=⟨1,2,3⟩$ and $b=⟨2,-3,x⟩.$ Given that the projection of $a$ onto $b$ is the zero vector, find the value of $x.$
q-212206.worked_solution:
Since $a$ is a nonzero vector, its projection onto another nonzero vector $b$ equals the zero vector only when the vectors are perpendicular. 

So, we must have

$$
a⊥b\,⟹\,a\cdot b=0.
$$

Computing the dot product, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y}+{a}_{z}\cdot {b}_{z} \\  & =1\cdot 2+2\cdot (-3)+3\cdot x \\  & =3x-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ 3x-4 & =0 \\ 3x & =4 \\ x & =\frac{4}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-212461.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -1 \\ x\end{aligned}].$ Given that the projection of $a$ onto $b$ is the zero vector, find the value of $x.$

Since $a$ is a nonzero vector, its projection onto another nonzero vector $b$ equals the zero vector only when the vectors are perpendicular. 

So, we must have

$$
a⊥b\,⟹\,a\cdot b=0.
$$

Computing the dot product, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y}+{a}_{z}\cdot {b}_{z} \\  & =-4\cdot 4+4\cdot (-1)+1\cdot x \\  & =x-20.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ x-20 & =0 \\ x & =20.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $a$ is a nonzero vector, its projection onto another nonzero vector $b$ equals the zero vector only when the vectors are perpendicular.

$$
